source_note: 证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的
english_source_note: Nonexistence of a Limit for Sine on the Integers
callout_id: 证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的#4
statement_en: Prove that the set $E$ formed by the sequence $\xi_n=n\text{ mod }2\pi$ is dense in the interval $[0,2\pi]$.
callout_body: 证明$\xi_n=n\text{ mod }2\pi$这个序列形成的集合$E$是区间$[0,2\pi]$当中的稠密子集。
